description: This file is a React component for ticket generation in a ticketing web application. It provides UI for creating, managing, and exporting tickets for an event, including features to preview, download PDFs, and send email links.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates attendee information for a specific row based on index.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a blank attendee row to the list.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes an attendee row based on the provided index.

methods.name: onGenerate
methods.description: Handles ticket generation process, including validations and API call.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Downloads the ticket PDF for a given ticket ID.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Sends an email with the ticket link for a given ticket ID.
